claim_boundary: This protocol tests whether a correction magnitude calibrated on one opened interaction transfers to another untouched interaction of the same physical object. It compares the frozen instance scale with both the released checkpoint and the globally validated 0.125 correction. The cohort differs from the published eighteen-take split, so the published 6.498 mm value remains contextual rather than a table-SOTA gate.

custody.prediction_frames: all contiguous f from 6 through the last robot frame; active-frame filtering occurs only during locked scoring
custody.registered_source_archive_evidence: canonical opaque-stage manifest binds the registered ZIP hash and every transferred member hash
custody.retry_policy: no replacement; technical failures and exact fallbacks remain in the registered cohort
custody.scored_frames: force-y at f exceeds 3 N, matching the registered official evaluator
custody.target_mesh_access_before_barrier: geometry decoding and scoring forbidden; opaque byte-preserving archive extraction allowed
custody.template_mesh: allowed explicit task input selected by the frozen upstream robot-metadata rule

evaluation.aggregation: equal-weight physical objects over twelve prospectively selected public takes; frame-level values are diagnostic
evaluation.invalid_jaccard_action: report the failure and valid fraction; never substitute a voxel or repaired-mesh surrogate
evaluation.jaccard_definition: trimesh boolean intersection volume divided by union volume
evaluation.jaccard_role: non-gating reproducibility diagnostic because the released target meshes are not guaranteed volumetric
evaluation.primary_definition: mean nearest-neighbor L1 distance from deterministically sampled predicted surface points to target surface points in original metric coordinates

forbidden: opening any scored deformed mesh before all twelve prediction seals pass the barrier
using frame f Kinect or robot observations to predict frame f
substituting T_WT for missing T_WE or otherwise imputing a required actuator pose
changing the instance multiplier map, support radius, metric, aggregation, or gate after target access
replacing any selected take or a technically failed prediction
tuning from any of the twelve second-cohort target outcomes
representing the physical objects as unseen during source development
substituting a repaired-mesh or voxel Jaccard for the registered public-mesh diagnostic
claiming reproduction of or direct comparison with the published eighteen-object aggregate
touching any held-v8 artifact or process

direct_metric_reference.scope: paired instance candidate versus released checkpoint over all twelve prospectively selected takes

instance_advancement.bootstrap_unit: physical object among all twelve second-cohort takes
instance_advancement.reference: frozen global correction scale 0.125 on the same predictions

paired_transfer.bootstrap_unit: physical object among all twelve prospectively selected public takes

method.missing_required_robot_pose_action: mark update unsupported and return byte-identical released checkpoint
method.online_selector: none; one object-level multiplier is fixed pre-target
method.required_action_history: finite T_WT, T_WE, and force values for every frame used by the frozen action-local field
method.scale_policy: source-calibrated per physical object with frozen capped bank
method.state_update: robust correlation-aware graph registration at f-1
method.transfer: one material-vertex-identity step from f-1 to f

official_reference.fresh12_scope: twelve second-cohort public recordings; only paired checkpoint and global-scale comparisons are authorized
official_reference.paper: PokeFlex: A Real-World Dataset of Deformable Objects for Physics-Based Reconstruction
official_reference.published_split_scope: one hard-coded validation recording per each of eighteen objects

status: pre-outcome lock for source-calibrated instance shrinkage on twelve second-cohort public takes

target_cohort.freshness_scope: exact take IDs are unexposed in the registered audit; physical object instances and source interactions are not new
target_cohort.selection_basis: minimum SHA-256 of the frozen v2 salt, NUL, and take ID within each remaining eligible object after excluding the original exposure union and the first fresh12 target
